title: AI Senior Business System Consultant
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
As part of AbbVie’s Business Technology Solutions (BTS) team, R&D Global Therapeutics is dedicated to building and deploying scalable, business-driven Artificial Intelligence (AI) Applications. We are seeking an innovative and highly skilled AI Senior Business Systems Consultant, to lead the strategy and execution of automation initiatives, with an emphasis on AI safety solutions.
In this role, you will manage the deployment of both AI and traditional products and solutions. You will work closely with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to identify, select, and consult on the appropriate AI technologies to be deployed. Proactively seeks out strategic business opportunities with high-level business unit executives. Provide advice, assistance and leadership in any area associated with the planning, procurement, provision, delivery, management, maintenance, and effective business use of information systems for a business area. Analyze business processes; elicit, analyze, and document business requirements; identify alternative solutions, assess feasibility, and make recommendations typically seeking to exploit and leverage new or existing technology components. Translate business requirements into functional requirements; perform data and process modeling; manage change; and lead, coordinate/perform testing, verification, and validation of requirements.​
Responsibilities:
Work with senior business unit clients to understand specific business processes, business drivers, and business strategy across multiple functions; Personally, or through indirect team management identify, prioritize and communicate resulting needs and opportunities for business process improvement that can be enabled via technology; Use consulting skills and expertise to translate business requirements to BTS and functional requirements to the domain.
Investigate and understand capabilities of existing systems and technologies already in use across the business area and similar and interconnected business areas in AbbVie and investigate available technologies applied to this business area in industry; identify information required to support the business strategy and lead the development of appropriate information management strategies and developing them as an integrated part of the business strategy.
Define needed human and technology capabilities contributing to and helping to build necessary training. Mentor, Identify, communicate, and actively participate in opportunities to improve process and/or technology. These may include business process outsourcing, application development, or adopting business process management (BPM) practices.
Accountable for the creation and further refinement of project requirements and for BTO Demand initiation and coordination.  Anticipate project/program risks, define mitigation plans, and work with teams to implement. Working with business partners and BTO management, responsible for resolving changes to scope, issues, and risks that will affect multiple and/or large-scale projects/programs.
Simultaneously consider objectives of multiple functions. Measure performance to ensure the project is progressing as compared to original plan and budget. Accountable for the accuracy of the fit of the proposed business process improvements and the technical solution to the business need and the information upon which the business justification and prioritization decisions are made. Understand and execute AbbVie's vision, goals and strategies and use this understanding to broker services.
As an individual contributor adeptly navigate cross-functional and highly matrixed teams through indirect authority. Has defined authority and responsibility for a significant area of work, including technical, financial, and quality aspects, and delegate assignments across multiple and/or large-scale projects/programs. Accountable for actions and decisions taken by self and project teams.
Anticipate and respond to current and emerging business needs and evaluate alternative IT solutions using standard information systems methodologies and best practices. Determine necessary resources to ensure program and business needs are addressed through proactive priority management with business leaders. Manage, motivate, and mentor cross-functional and enterprise project teams. Work with governance bodies to ensure alignment.
Build collaborative relationships and effectively interact frequently with business and/or technology senior leaders. Act as a liaison and business process expert to IT organizations to ensure successful implementation. Serve as a source of information to the service organizations on the business drivers, processes, and organization structure and dynamics of multiple business areas. Subject matter expert in their technology and/or functional domain.
Interact well with diverse groups within function and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external collaborators. Consistently demonstrate AbbVie's Ways of Working and Leadership Attributes including an enterprise mindset and people leadership. Serve as a mentor to develop and recognize talent. Ability to communicate problems in terms that are understandable to BTS Leadership and end users at all levels.
Required:
Bachelor's Degree with 8 years of experience; Master's Degree with 7 years of experience; PhD with 3 years of experience.
3+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, or similar role in a technical environment or product management.
Strong leadership and team management abilities, with experience leading cross-functional teams.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Proven track record of managing the development and launch of successful software products.
Knowledge of software development best practices.
Proficiency in Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence).
Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.
Preferred:
​ Understanding of Large Language Models, Generative AI, traditional AI and how to apply them and select for best fit.
​Experience working in the Life Sciences industry.
​Experience with GxP validated systems​.
Technical Writing Skills

Biologics Drug Product Development (Bio DPD), a part of Development Sciences within AbbVie’s R&D, is a global organization that is responsible for drug product formulation and process development, and definition of the product presentation for biologics (proteins, conjugates, peptides, neurotoxins etc.) and genetic medicine (AAV, LNPs, Cell Therapy).
AbbVie is seeking a highly motivated candidate for the position of Director, located in North Chicago, IL. We are seeking an accomplished scientist with a proven track record in biologics drug product development. This position will be an integral part of the product development and CMC teams and will have strong collaborations with several stakeholders, including discovery research, analytical research and development, bioprocess development, combination products development, product development science and technology, pilot plants and third-party manufacturers.
The role could be filled at the associate director or director level depending on the candidate's qualifications and experience.
Key Responsibilities:
Provide strategic and technical oversight for drug product development of ultra-high concentration drug product formulation and process development and technology transfer, including fixed dose combinations for a wide range of biologics modalities.
Oversee drug product development of a portfolio of 5-7 pipeline programs spanning early- and late-stage development, including management of external partnerships as appropriate.
Effective and timely communication of development plans, risks, and mitigation plans to stakeholders and line management.
Initiate and/or sponsor scientific initiatives to drive innovation, continuously enhance capabilities and platforms, and improve business processes.
Accountable for the timely authoring of high-quality technical reports as well as drug product sections in global regulatory filings.
Serve as drug product development subject matter expert in due diligence of external opportunities.
Supervise and mentor a team of 8-10 scientists that may include technical group leaders.
This position can be hired at either the Associate Director or Director level depending on education and years of experience.
Required Qualifications:
Director: BS, MS, or PhD in Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or related disciplines with 18+ (Bachelors), 16+ (Masters), or 10+ (PhD) years of relevant industry experience.
Associate Director: BS, MS, or PhD in Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or related disciplines with 16+ (Bachelors), 14+ (Masters), or 8+ (PhD) years of relevant industry experience.
Proven ability to solve critical scientific problems.
Extensive experience in biologics (proteins, conjugates, peptides and/or neurotoxins), parenteral synthetic molecules and/or genetic medicine (AAV, LNPs, cell therapy) drug product development.
Experience in sterile manufacturing unit operations (freeze-thaw, compounding, mixing, filtration and filling, lyophilization) development.
Experience leading drug product development as the functional lead within cross-functional teams.
5+ years of progressive people management roles.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with development and commercialization of ultra-high concentration liquid formulations for fixed dose combinations and drug product-device integration.
Hands-on experience with authoring regulatory filings for biologics and sterile parenteral products.
Understanding of relevant cGMP and regulatory guidance for biologics and sterile parenteral products.
Experience in managing third-party manufacturers of sterile parenteral products.
Experience with quality risk management and control strategies for biologics and sterile parenteral products.
Key Competencies:
Deep scientific knowledge and significant hands-on experience with ultra-high co-formulation development and characterization.
Effectively communicates to influence without authority, drives technical excellence, and inspires continuous improvement.
Builds strong relationships with peers and cross-functional partners to enable higher performance.

The Global Research, Informatics & Platform Solutions team within the Information Research (IR) Division partners with scientists and research organizations across AbbVie to unlock the value of scientific data. By enabling effective management, integration, and use of high-quality research data and delivering informatics platforms and decision-support capabilities, the team helps transform complex scientific information into actionable insights that accelerate discovery, strengthen scientific decision-making, and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of research and development. Harmonization – apply previous biology/biochemistry wet lab experience and strong knowledge of biology data to harmonize knowledge graph data & derive knowledge statements.
Communicate – ability to communicate with scientists from Discovery teams to understand existing workflows, data flows & gather requirements.
Collaborative Design – understand the client’s needs, propose solutions, and independently develop appropriate solutions.
Build – Conceive, design, and implement technology solutions that integrate, visualize, and analyze complex multi-platform data; build pipelines to integrate data into systems/warehouses.

Support – provide solutions to performance-related issues and work with downstream systems to support bioassay-data-driven demands.

Strong familiarity with data visualization and pipelining tools such as Spotfire, or equivalent
Demonstrated data visualization skill and experience with flexible plotting libraries (D3, ggplot2, plotly) and/or visualization platforms.
Ability to work independently, multi-task, and work within timelines.
Outstanding verbal, written and interpersonal skills for cross-functional collaboration, including documenting and presenting technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders.
A self-motivated learner and thinker with a hands-on approach
Preferred:
Demonstrated technical proficiency in the pharmaceutical industry highly preferred.
Previous in vitro biology wet lab experience preferred.
Experience with LIMS, ELN, and other scientific software preferred.
Strong programming proficiency in Python (and other modern languages) desired.

description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The Analytics and Performance Excellence (APEX) team is an industry-recognized center of research excellence and strategic vision. We function as in-house strategic counsel — translating advanced analytics into business decisions and patient impact. We invest in diverse talent, cultivate new capabilities, and foster an inclusive culture where the best ideas win.
Role Summary
As Senior Manager within the Market Access & Patient Services Insights group, you will independently lead analytics and market research initiatives that shape U.S. Immunology brand strategy. You will identify payer opportunities, assess risk scenarios, and deliver actionable recommendations that advance patient access and provider reimbursement — with a particular emphasis on the medical benefit landscape, buy-and-bill dynamics, and ASP-driven pricing strategy.
Key Responsibilities
Analytics & Data Science
Lead advanced analytics across utilization management, medical policy, pricing, and competitive launch assessment.
Apply modeling, data science, and visualization tools to surface actionable business insights.
Develop contracting strategies grounded in quantitative analysis of specialty pharmacies, PBMs, GPOs, health plans, and medical benefit access dynamics.
Analyze reimbursement and access trends spanning buy-and-bill, ASP, site of care, and provider-administered therapies.
Mine healthcare and operational datasets to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improved access and execution.
Market Research
Design and execute market research initiatives assessing payer dynamics, access barriers, and competitive positioning.
Synthesize qualitative and quantitative findings into clear, strategy-ready insights.
Track competitive launches and evolving healthcare policy through rigorous research methodologies.
Inform medical benefit access, provider-administered therapy, and reimbursement strategy through targeted insights development.
Strategic Leadership & Collaboration
Present analytics and research findings to senior leadership; influence high-impact, cross-functional decisions.
Mentor junior team members in analytics and market research capabilities.
Collaborate cross-functionally with market access, field teams, analytics partners, and external stakeholders to convert insights into action.
Champion an innovative, high-performing, and inclusive team culture.
Required
Bachelor's degree in Science, Business, Analytics, Health Economics, or a related field.
6+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in pharmaceutical or healthcare analytics, market access, or a closely related role.
Direct industry experience across payer, manufacturer, consulting, or vendor environments supporting pharma/healthcare clients.
Proficiency in one or more analytic tools (SQL, Python, R, Dataiku, or equivalent) and data visualization platforms (e.g., Power BI).
Proven ability to independently lead projects and deliver strategic insights in fast-paced, cross-functional settings.
Superior communication skills — able to distill complex analyses into clear, compelling narratives for senior audiences.
Working knowledge of medical benefit access, reimbursement dynamics, and provider-administered therapy models.
Preferred
Advanced degree (Master's, MBA, MPH, or equivalent).
In-depth U.S. market access experience: value/contracting strategy, reimbursement policy analytics, or access barrier assessment.
Hands-on experience with syndicated pharma data sources (e.g., IQVIA, Symphony Health, DRG, MMIT).
Familiarity with statistical modeling, machine learning, or predictive analytics methodologies.
Exposure to infusion provider operations, onboarding processes, or related operational data is a welcome plus.

Purpose:
The Sr. Manager, Regional Materials Management is responsible for leading regional materials management activities for raw materials, commodities, and shared critical supplies across the biologics manufacturing region. Technical delivery leadership

Run short, iterative delivery cycles (e.g., discovery sprints, weekly demos) that move rapidly from hypothesis to a working solution in users’ hands.
Make clear build/buy/scale decisions and define the path from prototype to production with BTS platform, product, and support teams.
Frontline partnership
Travel to AbbVie sites to work directly with frontline employees—on the manufacturing floor, in labs, in Quality and in Finance—to observe workflows, understand pain points and co-design solutions.
Translate ambiguous operational and financial problems into well-defined technical problems with measurable success criteria (e.g., cycle time, yield, right-first-time, deviation reduction, close timeliness).
Build trusted relationships with site leaders and business stakeholders; communicate progress, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Hands-on solution development
Rapidly develop prototypes using data science, machine learning, generative AI / LLM and agentic tools, analytics, and application development frameworks.
Integrate with enterprise and operational data sources such as MES, LIMS, QMS, ERP (e.g., SAP), historians, and data lake / cloud platforms.
Apply AI-assisted development practices to accelerate delivery while maintaining code quality, security, and maintainability.
Ensure solutions are designed with appropriate data integrity, privacy, cybersecurity, and responsible AI considerations, and engage Quality/CSV partners early where GxP impact exists.
Scale and impact
Capture reusable patterns, components and playbooks so successful solutions can be replicated across sites and functions.
Quantify and report business value delivered by FDE engagements; help shape the FDE engagement model and pipeline with BTS Operations & Finance leadership.

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, a physical/life science, or related field with 7 years of relevant experience; Master’s Degree with 6 years of experience; or PhD with 2 years of experience.

Proven track record leading technical teams—setting direction, mentoring engineers and accountable for delivery of multiple concurrent projects.
Strong hands-on engineering skills in Python and SQL, with experience building and deploying ML/AI solutions, including generative AI / LLM applications.
Experience with cloud data and compute platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Databricks, Snowflake) and modern software practices (Git, CI/CD, APIs, containerization).
Experience working in rapid, iterative delivery environments—taking ambiguous problems to working prototypes on short timelines.
Working knowledge of regulated environments (GxP, data integrity, computerized system validation) and how they shape solution design.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable working directly with frontline staff and presenting to senior leaders.
Willingness and ability to travel to sites up to 20% of the time.

Prior forward deployed, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or internal innovation “skunkworks” team experience.
Familiarity with manufacturing and quality systems and data (MES, LIMS, QMS, historians such as OSIsoft PI) and/or finance systems (SAP, planning and close tools).
Experience with agentic AI frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, computer vision, or optimization/simulation methods.
Experience with full-stack or low-code application development for rapid user-facing tools (e.g., React, Streamlit, Power Apps).
Experience moving prototypes to scaled, supported production solutions in partnership with platform and product teams.

- Assist in architecting chip and system level verification environments.
- Use System Verilog and UVM to develop drivers, tests, reference models and checkers
- Debug test failures and work with designers to develop fixes

description:

Demonstrated ability to drive investigations independently — comfortable testing hypotheses, establishing root cause, and applying policy and remediation strategies
Demonstrated experience mentoring and coaching other responders, sharing expertise in a way that measurably improves the work of those around you

Working competence across several of: endpoint/OS internals, cloud control planes, SaaS platforms, corporate IT infrastructure, and developer/CI-CD environments
Experience in malware analysis, digital forensics, intrusion detection, and/or threat intelligence

description:

You will serve as a senior technical security partner to application engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, platform engineering, and Apple Information Security teams.
Sales and Operations Engineering is part of IS&T and drives the technology behind Apple's global operations, sales, and supply chain. The team connects the systems that move products from factory to customer — bridging sales platforms with the operational infrastructure that keeps Apple running at scale and ensuring Apple's technology and business priorities move in lockstep.
In this role, you will lead complex security assessments and threat modeling, define scalable security controls, influence application and infrastructure architecture, and develop automation that enables security to be embedded throughout the software development lifecycle. You will identify systemic security risks and create engineering solutions that improve security across multiple applications and teams rather than relying on manual or application-specific controls. 8+ years of experience leading security reviews, threat modeling, risk assessments, and remediation of complex distributed or cloud-native systems.

title: Sr. AI Inference Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking for senior engineer to build tooling, automation, and analysis capabilities that strengthen our AI inference platform. This role will focus on developing sophisticated performance benchmarking systems, capacity projection models, and data analysis pipelines that directly inform our AI infrastructure teams and capacity planners. Cox Fleet keeps your fleet moving!
Headquartered in Indianapolis, Cox Fleet has grown to become one of the largest fleet maintenance companies in the country.
Cox Fleet is the leading provider of on-site mobile maintenance and repair services nationwide, offering mobile on-site fleet service for light medium, and heavy-duty trucks and trailers. Cox Fleet also services customers utilizing its 50+ nationwide service centers; each offering accident repair, painting, refurbishment, and heavy mechanical repair. Cox Fleet is currently hiring a Mobile Diesel Technician Level II.
The Mobile Diesel Technician Level II will be responsible for performing licensed DOT inspections, Preventative Maintenance inspections, light and follow-up repairs, light mechanical/hydraulic/electrical and electronic diagnostics, and other duties as assigned.  The Mobile Diesel Technician II can perform more advanced diagnostics and repairs under the supervision of a Sr Mobile Diesel Technician or higher. The Diesel Technician II continues to learn additional advanced mechanical skills and diagnostic techniques.  A successful Diesel Technician II complies with all company policies and achieves high level performance metrics.
DUTIES:
Perform scheduled preventative maintenance (“PM”), DOT Inspections and follow up repairs on light, medium and heavy-duty vehicles in a mobile/field environment.
Perform minor adjustment and repairs on various types of truck equipment including, but not limited to the following: Electrical/Brake/Cooling Systems, Starters/Alternators, Fan clutches, Engine electronics, Diesel steering systems, Engines (gas and diesel), Transmissions (manual and automatic), Clutches, Differentials, etc.
Diagnose, adjust, and repair various types of truck equipment including, but not limited to the following: Electrical/Brake/Cooling Systems, Starters/Alternators, Air conditioning systems, Fan clutches, Engine electronics, Diesel steering systems, Engines (gas and diesel), Transmissions (manual and automatic), Clutches, Differentials, etc.
Inspect, test, and listen to defective equipment to diagnose malfunctions, using test instruments such as handheld computers and pressure gauges.
Road test vehicles to diagnose malfunctions and to ensure that they are working properly.
Identify problems, determine accuracy and relevance of information, using sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives.
Independently manage parts inventory and equipment provided on company-issued service truck and perform periodic reconciliation.
Maintain and operate company-issued service vehicle, conduct safety checks, and pre-/post-trip inspections of vehicle.
Work with and listen effectively to clients and customers to assess their needs, providing information or assistance, resolving their problems, or satisfying their expectations.
Manage concurrent assigned tasks, making effective judgments as to prioritizing work related activities and time allocations.
Use hand tools, precision instruments, as well as Diesel tools, welding equipment, lift and jacks.
Document according to company standards and upload pictures of work performed, parts used, and all findings observed on Repair Orders (“RO”) using company-issued iOS device and our proprietary TRAIT application.
Accurately complete DOT forms and all other forms of documentation in a timely fashion.
Work with a high degree of independence and manage own daily schedule.
Maintain a high level of productivity and be able to work within or close to most Standard Repair Times.
Obtain parts from approved local and national vendors as necessary for the repairs to be performed.
Communicate with management and support team via email or phone to obtain approvals on repair estimates, retrieve purchase order numbers and/or discuss RO findings notes.
Perform all work in compliance with organizational safety, health and environmental policies, and federal regulations, to include OSHA, EPA, and DOT.
Maintain company issued service truck, conduct safety checks and daily pre/post trip inspections.
REQUIREMENTS:
High School Diploma/GED and 3 years’ experience in a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as any level degree/certification beyond a HS diploma/GED in a related discipline; or 5 years’ experience in a related field.
Possess and supply a set of hand tools necessary to perform required job duties.
Obtain Automotive Service Excellence (ASE) certification T8 (PMI) within eighteen (18) months.
This position follows regulations issued by the Department of Transportation’s (DOT) Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA). Candidate must be able to successfully complete and pass a DOT-regulated pre-employment background screening and DOT physical prior to employment.
A current and valid DOT medical card with more than four (4) months remaining until its expiration may be submitted in leu of a DOT physical. If the DOT medical card has four (4) months or less of validity remaining, a DOT physical will be required.

By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for local cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about — helping grow businesses and the communities that support those businesses. To further this mission, we’re looking for an experienced consumer growth marketer to join our growing consumer marketing team at a pivotal and exciting time for DoorDash.
The consumer growth marketing team is focused on building and nurturing our consumer base by building a relationship with our consumer and providing them with an engaging and relevant cross-channel experience. You’ll be responsible to developing our affiliate creator initiative into a best-in-industry program, deepening our relationships with publishers, maintaining an innovative testing roadmap, and driving growth across DoorDash’s offerings. Own and scale a developing channel at DoorDash

Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of 3-4 direct reports responsible for campaign execution, creator recruitment and onboarding, commissioning strategy, measurement and tracking, and reporting
Stay at the forefront of affiliates innovation by experimenting with new publishers, tech partners, platform features, and in-house product capabilities

Fortune Brands Innovations (NYSE: FBIN) is an industry-leading home, security and digital products company with a portfolio of trusted brands, including Moen, House of Rohl, Therma-Tru, Larson, Master Lock, Yale residential, and Sentry Safe.
We are building a company that is determined to win, and we are clear about how: strong brands, great people, and disciplined execution.
You'll join a team that puts customers first, keeps its commitments, and cuts through complexity to deliver meaningful results.
If you're looking for an opportunity to make an impact and help shape what's next for our iconic brands, we'd love to meet you. Apply now.
Explore life at Fortune Brands here .
Getting the right product to the right place — on time, complete and undamaged — is how we keep our promises to customers. As Director, Distribution & Transportation for our Security business, you'll own the strategy behind that promise: the multi-site distribution network, the carrier partnerships, and the long-term direction of how we move product.
This is a seat with real scope. You'll lead the team that runs the network, sit at the table with commercial and operations leaders, and own the service performance our customers feel every day.
Position location – This will be a hybrid-based position within driving distance of the following location: Deerfield, IL. (Flexibility to work from home Mondays and Fridays.)
RESPONSIBLIITIES:
Establish and execute the distribution, transportation, and network strategy for the Security business, aligning logistics capabilities with growth objectives, customer expectations, and operational requirements.
Lead a multi-site distribution network, ensuring safe, efficient, and cost-effective operations across all facilities.
Own end-to-end transportation strategy, including carrier selection, contract negotiations, rate management, and ongoing performance oversight.
Develop and optimize the transportation and distribution network to improve service levels, reduce costs, enhance scalability, and support evolving business needs.
Deliver best-in-class customer service performance through reliable on-time, in-full, and damage-free delivery execution.
Partner closely with Commercial, Operations, Manufacturing, Customer Service, Procurement, and Supply Chain leadership to drive cross-functional initiatives and business results.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) including service, cost, inventory flow, transportation efficiency, carrier performance, and warehouse productivity.
Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives leveraging Lean, Six Sigma, and supply chain best practices to drive operational excellence.
Lead annual logistics and transportation planning processes, including budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
Manage third-party logistics providers (3PLs), warehouse partners, and transportation vendors to ensure performance expectations and contractual obligations are met.
Evaluate emerging technologies, systems, and automation opportunities that enhance visibility, productivity, and customer experience across the distribution network.
Build, develop, and mentor a high-performing team, creating organizational capability, succession plans, and career development opportunities.
Ensure compliance with all applicable transportation, safety, regulatory, and environmental requirements.
Provide executive-level reporting and recommendations regarding network performance, strategic opportunities, risks, and investment priorities.
Set the distribution and logistics strategy for the Outdoors business and shape its long-term direction.
10+ years of leadership experience across transportation, logistics or supply chain.
A bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Finance, Business Administration, Marketing or a related field — or equivalent experience. MBA preferred.
Demonstrated success leading a multi-site distribution network.
Experience managing carrier relationships, including negotiations and performance management.
A track record of leading teams, influencing stakeholders and driving cross-functional initiatives.
Accountability for service metrics — on-time, in-full and damage-free delivery.
Willingness and ability to travel up to 30%.

Experience with Python, Microsoft SQL databases, HTML, Java, and Expression languages a must
Demonstrated software application implementations into a production environment
Go-to person for daily software support activities

Identify operational efficiencies through supply‑chain insights.
Deep dive service-related issues and drive DC performance across the network
Enhance Customer Buying Agreement processes and support customer service excellence.
Collaborate across supply chains, suppliers, and customers to drive solutions.
Lead change‑management activities by assessing impacts and driving execution.
Manage performance dashboards including DC Daily, REVREC, and Quarter‑End Ship Down.
Deliver training on new systems, TMS, routing tools, and vendor portals.
Develop strong, forward‑thinking leaders across operations.
Maintain OS&D Receiving Site standards.

Minimum of 10 years of relevant supply chain/manufacturing experience in roles of increasing responsibility inclusive of a minimum of 5 years of experience leading large scale, highly complex cross-functional strategic initiatives following a formal project management methodology (including tools and techniques) and/or Six Sigma DMAIC discipline is required.
Experience in supply chain end-to-end processes including demand planning, supply planning, scheduling, capacity management, and/or logistics is required.  A minimum of 3 years in a lead role is preferred.
Experience operating in an ERP environment (SAP preferred) is preferred.
Supply Chain and Six Sigma expertise gained through training, certification, and/or industry associations is preferred (e.g., APICS, Six Sigma, Lean Six Sigma, PMP).

title: Quality Auditor Meridian
description:
Key Responsibilities:
Technical Knowledge
The individual in this role must have a thorough understanding of quality control including:
Measurement and test equipment use and calibrations including hand tools, gauges, optical tools, balances, color meters, and force measuring instruments.
Data entry and analysis methods.
Quality management system compliance.
Process improvement and problem solving approaches.
Area management and housekeeping best practices.
Risk assessment reasoning.
Nonconforming materials and rework handling.
Sampling plans and proper sample preparation.
Inspection techniques and processes.
Auditing.
Core Skills
The individual in this role must demonstrate mastery in the following areas:
Writing Skills : Write clear, simple sentences, complete technical forms, and apply basic math concepts like estimation and spatial reasoning.
Reading Skills : Interpret manuals, safety instructions, reports, and understand images, graphs, and coding systems in the work area.
Oral Skills : Communicate effectively, respond to questions, and collaborate with supervisors and team members to support plant improvements.
Motivation : Take responsibility for assignments, improve skills, and set personal goals with actionable strategies.
Integrity : Be honest with company property and time, communicate respectfully, and resolve conflicts constructively.
Reliability : Maintain punctuality, stay composed in stressful situations, and work effectively in a structured environment.
Minimum Qualifications:
Required
Ability to work 12-hour shifts in a continuous manufacturing environment.
Willingness to work overtime, holidays, and weekends as scheduled.
Proficiency with using a computer.
Proficiency using Microsoft Office Suite products.
Ability to operate a forklift.
Strong cross-functional communication skills.
At least 18 years of age.
Preferred
High School Diploma or GED.
Strong English, reading, and writing skills for career advancement, including the ability to interpret safety rules, operating instructions, maintenance manuals, and procedural documents.
Previous forklift operation experience.
Previous manufacturing experience.
Physical Requirements
The physical requirements outlined below represent those necessary for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be provided for individuals with disabilities.
Lift, push, and pull, up to 50 pounds.
Stand and walk around for a 12.5+ hour shift.
Perform physical tasks such as bending, squatting, and kneeling.
Ability to operate various different styles of forklifts
Wear and operate required safety equipment, including earplugs and safety glasses.
Read printed reports and data displayed on computer screens.
Fine motor skills to operate tools, including chop saws, staple guns, calipers and other test equipment.
The use of personal protective equipment (PPE), such as safety eyewear, steel-toed boots, and hearing protection, is mandatory in designated areas. While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is often exposed to hot and wet and/or humid conditions; occasionally moving mechanical parts and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

As Regional Sales Manager for the Midsouth region, you will own sales growth for our House of Rohl brands across the region's target markets and luxury product categories. You will set the regional strategy, lead the team that executes it, and be accountable for meeting or exceeding the sales plan. You will partner with the VP of Sales on how the region goes to market and bring what you see in the field to senior leadership.
POSITION LOCATION/TRAVEL: This is a remote, field-based role supporting the Mid-South region (TX, LA, MS, OK, AR, TN, KY), with a strong preference for candidates residing within the region near a major metropolitan area, such as Dallas–Fort Worth, Nashville, Memphis, Little Rock, or Oklahoma City.
Regular travel throughout the territory is required to manage customer relationships and drive market growth, typically including 4–5 overnight trips per month , with additional travel as needed for key meetings and events. A company car, laptop, and cell phone will be provided.

Build and execute short and long-term sales strategies for every territory and segment that deliver the region's growth targets in line with the overall business strategy.
Meet or exceed sales targets by running and continuously evaluating market programs and strategies.
Partner with the Sales VP to set the regional go-to-market staffing model and own its execution and effectiveness.
Develop a deep understanding of regional market dynamics, manage distribution policy, and maintain strong working relationships across the channel.
Manage a high-performance culture through aggressive target setting, continuous evaluation, and performance management.
Lead internal cross-functional teams to drive growth in new products and segments, and drive execution of marketing programs while tracking the effectiveness of all advertising and marketing spend.
Monitor and report business trends, distribution patterns, consumer and trade attitudes, competitive practices, and product performance to senior leadership, and make sure every House of Rohl brand is represented to our quality standards in the marketplace.
Bachelor’s degree with at least 8 years of sales experience, OR a high school diploma with at least 12 years of sales experience.
Demonstrated progressive career growth in sales, with a proven track record of aggressively growing sales territories and driving revenue growth.
Demonstrated experience working with independent sales representative agencies.
Experience using a CRM system to manage customer relationships and sales activities.
Ability to manage 4–5 overnight trips per month, with additional travel as needed for key meetings and events.
Nice to Haves
3+ years of leadership experience.
Previous experience in luxury plumbing, hardware, and/or building materials.

description:

Company Description
Magnaflux , a division of Illinois Tool Works (Fortune 250), is a leading worldwide supplier of magnetic particle, dye penetrant inspection equipment and associated chemical products used for applications within the Aerospace, Automotive, Oil & Gas and Energy markets.
With over 85 years in the industry, Magnaflux offers employees a competitive salary and comprehensive benefit package, including medical, dental and life insurance, 401(k) with immediate company match, and much more!

Magnaflux is a global organization that designs, manufactures, sells and non-destructive testing systems.  Magnaflux is a clear global leader in non-destructive testing applications and its leadership in the marketplace is continually expanding.  You will find that our established strength, commitment to our core values and team focus provides an engaging work environment and offers exceptional opportunities for personal and career development.
The Strategic Sourcing Manager for the Magnaflux Division (an ITW company) is a critical functional head within the business, collaborating with all members of the Magnaflux Team to meet and exceed growth and profitability goals of the business.  Primary responsibilities include strategic sourcing, supply chain cost improvement and supplier accountability. This position also serves as a member of the operational management team providing a supply chain vision, business partnership, and collaboration with ITW to achieve strategic leverage and economy of scale objectives. The role encompasses manufacturing operations based out of DeWitt, IA covering more than $65M worth of equipment and blended chemical sales, and total divisional operations of $100M. As a senior functional head, this position is responsible for developing a team that will thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and are driven to excel.

Oversee day-to-day operational aspects of supply chain functions within the DeWitt, IA facility. Including purchase of raw materials, and/or parts, equipment, and supplies by preparing and submitting purchase orders.
Lead Strategic Sourcing for the Magnaflux Division and represent the Division as part of ITW Test & Measurement and Electronics Sourcing Leadership Team.
Ensure supply chain strategy, practices, and initiatives are aligned with the company’s business unit objectives and support the company’s growth and profitability strategy.
Lead the transition from a transactional purchasing department to a strategic sourcing organization.
Identify and execute sourcing initiatives that leverage purchasing scale, manage supply chain risk, and enhance profitability and global competitiveness.
Manage and negotiate supplier qualification and selection to ensure supplier quality, continuity, delivery, technology, and commercial requirements.
Develop and implement plans that harness economies of scale, drive economic value, and enable business growth by leveraging Magnaflux and ITW globally.
Lead complex and critical negotiations utilizing extensive professional knowledge and experience of principles and techniques of negotiation.

description:

As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

description:

As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care , our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion —have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare , you’ll find your purpose here.
Primary Function of Position
At Intuitive, we believe that minimally invasive care is life-enhancing care. By combining ingenuity and intelligent technology, we expand the potential of physicians to heal without constraints. We are looking for team members with exceptional character who have the capacity to simplify complex problems and the energy to deliver solutions urgently to our patients. Intuitive Accessories are the interface between all aspects of the da Vinci system and enable safe and effective robot-assisted surgery. Our customers interact directly with Accessories in every surgical procedure, and they serve a critical role in customer satisfaction and patient outcomes. The Staff Mechanical Design Engineer for Single-Port (SP) Accessories will support development and production of existing and new products. This position requires a hands-on, technically strong engineer to dive deep into solving engineering challenges, and to provide high-level assessment of risks and opportunities. Projects will include a mix of sustaining existing products and new product development, including improvements for cost savings and manufacturability to enable significant volume growth, enhancements to increase customer satisfaction, and improving reliability.

• Work cross-functionally with Manufacturing Engineers, Systems Analysts, Clinical Development Engineers, Human Factors Engineers, and Supplier Engineers.
• Review and understand product functional requirements and design specifications.

• Investigate and determine root cause of design, manufacturing, or material issues.
• Research, understand, and design to relevant product-specific international standards.
• Develop, implement, test, and document solutions that meet clinical, functional, and product requirements.
• Perform and document risk analyses (FMEA) and implement effective mitigations, following design control processes.
• Help identify and develop vendors to manufacture components.
• Develop initial fixtures and processes to assemble components.
• Develop product and component verification testing and product validation testing
• Support production of final product by troubleshooting process and component problems
• Provide engineering support to Manufacturing, Materials, Test Engineering, and Service to facilitate transfer of designs.
• Develop, implement, test and document solutions for these opportunities according to corporate standard and departmental operating procedures
• Mentor other engineers and champion best practices for mechanical design
Required Skills and Experience
• Proficiency using CAD to design and document mechanisms; SolidWorks strongly preferred
• Good communication and documentation skills
• Experience in designing high volume consumable medical products
• Strong working knowledge of GD&T
• Experience with complex interface compatibility and tolerance analysis
• Demonstrated knowledge of high-volume component manufacturing processes (including injection molding, plastics films, extrusions, thermoforming, and plastic bonding methods)
• Demonstrated knowledge of materials (preferably plastics, silicones, polyurethanes, isoprenes) and material properties. Ability to apply knowledge of engineering materials and component selection criteria to product designs through strong concept development, design analysis, hands-on prototyping, and reliability testing skills.
• Demonstrated ability to think at a systems level, interface between multiple design groups, and negotiate conflicting requirements.
• Comfortable with all phases of the product development lifecycle including design, implementation, debug, verification, qualification, and transfer.
• A passion for solving tough technical problems - Strong mechanical intuition and persistence to drill down to pinpoint root cause of problems, solving problems using fundamental principles.
• Ability to communicate effectively (written, oral) across functions, including presenting to a technical audience
• Prior experience working in medical device or other regulated industry
Required Education and Training
• Minimum education: BS in Mechanical Engineering required, MSME preferred. Biomedical or other engineering discipline may be acceptable with appropriate mechanical experience.
• Minimum 12 years of hardware product design experience preferred with undergraduate degree; minimum 8 years with graduate degree
Working Conditions
• Ability to lift 30 lbs. without assistance.
Preferred Skills and Experience (As applicable - Specific skills, knowledge, and experience that
are not required to perform the job, but are desirable to have)
• Comfortable operating machine shop tools/equipment, Rapid prototype equipment (3-d printers, laser cutters etc.), measurement and test equipment
• Knowledge in additional manufacturing processes such as extrusion, blow molding, ultrasonic welding, RF welding, heat staking, and laser welding
• Comfortable with concepts of design input, design output, traceability, and risk analysis
• Ability to handle ambiguity effectively and oversee multiple projects at once
• Knowledge of ISO requirements and GMP guidelines. Experience with FDA regulations and medical device design control a strong plus
• Experience leading departmental or cross-functional projects/initiatives from concept through completion
• Knowledge of sterilization methods, biocompatibility, and packaging of medical devices

title: Maintenance Manager

description:
Job Description
The Maintenance Manager leads the Davenport plant maintenance, reliability, utilities and plant engineering agenda to support safe, compliant, reliable and cost-effective operations. This leader owns the site Maintenance, Reliability & Engineering pillar within the Kraft Heinz Management System, builds technical capability, strengthens equipment ownership, and partners across plant functions to reduce losses and improve performance.
What You Will Do
Lead maintenance work in accordance with company EHS requirements, safe work practices and applicable regulatory standards, including LOTO, electrical safety, machine safety, hot work, confined space, work at height and contractor safety.
Provide leadership and governance for ammonia refrigeration and Process Safety Management activities, including mechanical integrity, Management of Change, PHA and audit action closure, procedures, training and emergency preparedness.
Ensure maintenance activities protect food safety and product quality through hygienic maintenance, foreign-material prevention, approved lubricants, sanitary design, post-maintenance release and coordination with Food Safety & Quality and Sanitation.
Own deployment and maturity of the KHMS Maintenance, Reliability & Engineering pillar, including daily performance routines, monthly pillar reviews, 90-day plans and escalation of barriers.
Maintain asset hierarchy, functional locations, asset master data and criticality rankings in the CMMS, and develop maintenance strategies based on asset criticality.
Create and govern a rolling 52-week maintenance plan and a two-week detailed schedule aligned with production windows, labor, skills, parts, tools, permits and contractor resources.
Improve preventive and proactive maintenance effectiveness and reduce reactive work using failure analysis, Pareto reviews, root-cause problem solving, troubleshooting guides and condition monitoring where justified.
Partner with Production and Sanitation on planned downtime, handoffs, start-up readiness and rapid response while maintaining long-term reliability discipline.
Support reliable operation and maintenance of utilities and facilities, including ammonia refrigeration, HVAC, compressed air, electrical distribution, water and wastewater, as assigned.
Manage maintenance projects through prioritization, design review, procurement, installation, commissioning, documentation, training and handoff to operations.
Support OT infrastructure and security controls in partnership with site and enterprise OT/IT resources.
Build and manage the annual maintenance budget and monthly forecast, review spending with Finance and take corrective action on variances.
Lead spare-parts and storeroom governance, including critical spares, min/max levels, obsolescence, cycle counts, kitting, repairable spares and stock-out reduction.
Select and manage contractors and OEMs, including scope, safety expectations, deliverables, cost controls, documentation and performance reviews.
Lead, coach and develop maintenance leaders, planners, technicians, utilities personnel and apprentices while building skills, accountability, succession and engagement in a unionized manufacturing environment.
What You Bring
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Maintenance, Reliability, Operations or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and progressively responsible experience.
Progressive leadership experience in maintenance or reliability within a high-speed manufacturing environment. Food or beverage manufacturing experience is strongly preferred.
Experience leading maintenance planning and scheduling, preventive or predictive maintenance, CMMS/SAP work management, root-cause analysis, equipment reliability and maintenance cost control.
Working knowledge of industrial mechanical, electrical, controls/automation, utilities and facility systems.
Experience leading people, contractors, budgets and cross-functional improvement work in a 24/7 manufacturing environment.
Ability to analyze operational and financial data, translate losses into action plans, communicate across organizational levels and sustain execution routines.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with ammonia refrigeration and OSHA Process Safety Management or EPA Risk Management Program requirements.
Experience with KHMS, TPM, WCM or another integrated manufacturing excellence system.
CMRP, CRL, PMP, Lean/Six Sigma, refrigeration/PSM or a related technical certification.
Experience in a unionized facility and with food-safety systems such as FSSC 22000, HACCP and GMPs.
Experience with condition monitoring, asset criticality, reliability-centered maintenance, storeroom optimization or capital project delivery.
Work Environment
Work is performed in an office and active food-manufacturing environment with machinery, wet areas, temperature variation, noise and required personal protective equipment.
The role requires frequent presence on the plant floor, including stairs, platforms, production, maintenance, utility and warehouse areas.
The role must be able to support plant needs outside normal business hours, including occasional evenings, nights, weekends, shutdowns and emergency responses.

title: Commodity Risk & Financial Analyst
description:
Job Description:
Key Responsibilities
Commodity Risk Management, Valuation & Reporting
Execute daily commodity risk management processes, including trade validation, trade reconciliation, exposure monitoring, and risk reporting across multiple commodities and regions.
Generate and maintain commodity exposure, hedge coverage, net open position, and market risk reports for business and leadership stakeholders.
Maintain and validate commodity forecast, pricing, position, and market data to ensure integrity and consistency across systems and reports.
Partner with Commodity Price Risk Managers to evaluate hedge structures, coverage strategies, and potential financial impacts of commodity market movements.
Support liquidity forecasting and reporting related to commodity hedging activities, including cash settlement requirements, margin obligations, and derivative-related cash flows.
Financial Analysis, P&L Attribution & Business Insights
Develop and maintain financial models, dashboards, and reporting tools to quantify commodity exposures, hedging performance, market risks, and business impacts across the global Mars Snacking portfolio.
Deliver P&L attribution and cause-of-change analysis, identifying key drivers of financial performance including commodity price movements, basis changes, hedge impacts, timing effects, and market structure shifts.
Conduct scenario analysis, sensitivity modeling, and risk and opportunity assessments to evaluate financial impacts and support strategic decision-making.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and business performance reviews by translating commodity market dynamics and hedging activities into clear financial outcomes.
Prepare executive-ready reporting and insights that communicate commodity exposures, financial impacts, risks, opportunities, and mitigation strategies.
Hedge Accounting, Financial Controls & Governance
Support hedge accounting programs through documentation, monitoring, and testing of designated hedging relationships in partnership with Treasury and Technical Accounting teams.
Perform prospective and retrospective hedge effectiveness testing to ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and maximize hedge accounting effectiveness.
Maintain a strong control environment around commodity transactions, trade validation, market data governance, curve management, and financial reporting processes.
Support internal and external audits by providing valuation support, reconciliation documentation, control evidence, and commodity risk reporting.
Ensure compliance with commodity risk management policies, financial controls, and governance requirements.
Systems, Data Management & Process Improvement
Serve as a key user and business owner for commodity risk management and CTRM systems, supporting system integrity, process controls, master data governance, and end-user adoption.
Reconcile data across CTRM platforms, broker statements, ERP systems, market data providers, and financial reporting systems.
Develop and enhance reporting and analytical solutions using Excel, VBA, SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, and other technology platforms.
Identify automation opportunities and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, reporting accuracy, transparency, and controls.
Support implementation, testing, and ongoing enhancement of commodity risk management systems and technology platforms.
Planning & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with Treasury, Technical Accounting, Finance, Procurement, S&OP, Commercial Finance, and Commodity Price Risk Managers to support commodity risk management objectives.
Support demand forecast validation and volume planning processes that underpin commodity exposure and hedge management activities.
Support budgeting, forecast updates, cause-of-change reporting, and business performance reviews in collaboration with Finance Business Partners.
Provide analytical support for business planning, sourcing decisions, commodity strategy development, and financial performance management.
Build strong relationships across Treasury, Procurement, Planning, Manufacturing, Commercial, and Finance teams, providing insights and executive-ready reporting to support business decisions.
Required Experience & Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Financial Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related analytical field.
Strong understanding of global commodity markets, trading, hedging, valuation methodologies, and risk management principles.
Experience supporting commodity risk management, treasury, commodity trading, market risk, financial planning, product control, or commodity finance organizations.
Experience developing financial models that combine commodity pricing, sourcing assumptions, exposure forecasts, hedge results, and business drivers to assess P&L impacts.
Experience with commodity exposure reporting, Mark-to-Market valuation, trade reconciliation, hedge effectiveness testing, financial controls, and P&L attribution analysis.
Advanced analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets and deliver actionable insights.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with SQL, Python, VBA, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical and reporting tools.
Experience with CTRM systems, ERP platforms, financial reporting systems, and market data providers preferred.
Demonstrated ability to perform data validation, reconciliation, valuation, financial analysis, and reporting in a fast-paced environment.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Excellent critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
Proactive mindset with a willingness to challenge discrepancies, improve processes, and recommend solutions.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively across global, cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated success operating within complex matrix organizations and collaborating with diverse internal and external stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting commodity trading, procurement, treasury, risk management, hedge accounting, or commodity finance organizations.
Knowledge of futures, options, swaps, OTC instruments, and hedge accounting methodologies.
Experience with independent price verification (IPV), P&L attribution, hedge effectiveness testing, and financial controls.
Experience working with CTRM systems, data warehouses, ERP systems, and business intelligence platforms.
Exposure to agricultural, dairy, energy, packaging, or other globally traded commodity markets.

Conversion - Manage the efforts of multi-line, area, or technology operating teams on one shift in efficiently converting materials into quality products in a safe, secure, and sanitary manner within the product design specifications.

title: Art Director
description:
About the Team

OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood, as it leaves the lab and meets the world.

This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told, in a way that feels grounded and human. We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn’t fit neatly into any of those categories yet. This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning.

About the Opportunity

We’re looking for a hands-on Art Director to help develop and make work across campaigns, research launches, and social. In the near term, you’ll focus on supporting research-related creative projects and launches, with opportunities to contribute more broadly.

You’re a visual thinker and a maker: someone who can find a strong visual idea, build a quick prototype, and carry it through to execution. You bring craft, curiosity, and resourcefulness, and enjoy creating content across mediums with a small team, a short timeline, or an evolving brief.

You’ll bring art direction and visual storytelling to projects that turn complex technology into ideas people connect with. Working closely with creative leads, copywriters, designers, and other creative partners, you’ll develop the visual approach and bring a distinctive point of view from concept through execution.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams, creators, and production partners, staying close to execution and using feedback to improve the work

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 8+ years of relevant experience

 - Bring a strong portfolio of campaign and social work that shows original thinking, distinctive art direction, and what you personally made, from early experiments to finished work

 - Have strong craft in art direction and design, with the range and curiosity to build across mediums and a strong instinct for culture and social platforms

description:
About the Team

OpenAI, in close collaboration with our capital partners, is building the world’s most advanced AI infrastructure ecosystem. The Compute team sets core infrastructure strategy and executes at global scale—spanning site selection through full buildout, in close partnership with internal and external stakeholders.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Commissioning and Quality Program Manager to oversee quality assurance, quality control and commissioning across all phases of our global hyperscale data center program. You will oversee the delivery quality for a massive portfolio of projects across several campuses. You’ll ensure work meets or exceeds OpenAI’s design standards, performance requirements, and reliability expectations—from early construction through commissioning and turnover to operations.

You’ll own development and enforcement of QA/QC standards, inspection protocols, commissioning scope, and acceptance criteria, working closely with contractors, design teams, and commissioning partners to embed a quality-first culture.

Travel: Up to 50%

Key Responsibilities

 - Develop and maintain the portfolio-level QA/QC program for hyperscale data center construction (standards, checklists, acceptance protocols).

 - Review and approve developer QA/QC and commissioning plans for alignment with project specs and industry best practices.

 - Oversee site inspections across civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, and electrical scopes.

 - Validate installation quality against drawings, specifications, and manufacturer requirements.

 - Monitor and track punch list items, NCRs, and corrective actions with the developer and contractors, including critical Method of Procedure (MOP) work.

 - Partner with the developer’s commissioning teams to ensure QA/QC documentation supports readiness for both functional and integrated testing.

 - Validate functional and integrated systems testing completion in preparation for OAI acceptance.

 - Maintain real-time quality tracking and reporting dashboards for program leadership.

 - Train and guide site teams on quality expectations, inspections, and documentation standards.

 - Drive continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned and updating standards for future sites.

Qualifications

 - Have 10+ years managing quality and commissioning for mission-critical, hyperscale, or complex commercial developments.

 - Have deep technical knowledge of construction means/methods and quality standards across major trades.

 - Can interpret design documents, specs, and submittals to verify field compliance.

 - Have experience developing and implementing quality management systems at program or portfolio scale.

 - Communicate effectively with executives, contractors, and site teams—translating findings into actionable recommendations.

 - Proactively identify quality risks before they impact cost or schedule.

 - Thrive in fast-paced, complex environments and can drive accountability across stakeholders.

Preferred Skills

 - This role is central to ensuring every system is delivered to spec, on time, and built to last—supporting OpenAI’s reliability expectations across a global hyperscale build program

 - Experience delivering QA/QC and commissioning programs for hyperscale data centers (e.g., >50MW campuses) across multiple regions.
   Familiarity with industry commissioning standards and frameworks (e.g., ASHRAE, Uptime Institute, CSA, BICSI).

 - Deep expertise in mission-critical MEP systems, including power (MV/LV), cooling (chilled water, DX), controls, and redundancy architectures (N, N+1, 2N).

 - Experience working with JDM/ODM or developer-led delivery models, including navigating multi-party accountability structures.

 - Proven track record managing third-party commissioning agents (CxA) and integrating their work into broader program QA/QC frameworks.

 - Strong understanding of digital QA/QC and commissioning tools (e.g., Procore, BIM 360, PlanGrid, CxAlloy, Bluebeam, or similar platforms).

 - Experience building and scaling portfolio-level quality dashboards and reporting systems for executive visibility.

 - Ability to operate effectively in global environments, including managing cultural, regulatory, and contractor differences across regions.

 - Background in failure analysis, root cause investigation, and reliability engineering for mission-critical infrastructure.

description:
About the team

Hardware Procurement Operations enables OpenAI’s hardware and infrastructure businesses to execute supplier engagements and purchases at speed while maintaining financial discipline, clear ownership, and effective controls.

Our work spans procurement execution, process and systems enablement, and lifecycle governance—from initial requests and agreements through purchasing, payment, and closeout, with related asset and inventory governance. We build practical operating models, resolve cross-functional barriers, and improve the tools and processes that help teams scale.

About the role

You will own procurement execution for complex infrastructure deals, including land transactions, lease agreements, power purchase agreements, and fast-moving colocation and fiber engagements. Scope may expand to cloud service provider (CSP) engagements and sourcing activities as business needs evolve.

This senior individual contributor role combines hands-on lifecycle management with commercial judgment and building scalable operations. You will recognize gaps in proposed supplier engagements, work with business owners, sourcing, Legal, and Finance to improve them, and translate agreements into executable purchasing and payment plans. You will also build standard processes and automation that help teams move faster while reducing deal risk.

In this role, you will:

 - Drive assigned engagements from intake and agreement execution through purchasing, ongoing obligations, amendments, renewals, final payments, and closeout.

 - Assess commercial and operational readiness, identify gaps in scope, deliverables, acceptance criteria, and payment terms, and drive resolution with the appropriate partners.

 - Resolve commercial, financial, and operational dependencies, aligning owners on required reviews and approvals. Represent procurement operations in deal planning and senior stakeholder escalations, presenting clear recommendations on commercial readiness, risks, and execution tradeoffs while respecting each function’s decision authority.

 - Maintain accurate obligation and purchasing records; coordinate payment readiness, acceptance evidence, invoice exceptions, and reconciliation with business owners, Treasury, Accounting, and Accounts Payable.

 - Establish procurement operating standards and influence business, sourcing, Legal, and Finance partners to adopt practices that improve supplier engagement quality, accelerate execution, and reduce risk. Build the processes, templates, playbooks, and upstream review cycles that make those standards actionable.

 - Design, implement, and manage workflow automation and AI agents, partnering with technical teams where needed; own testing, adoption, monitoring, exception handling, and appropriate human review and approval controls.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have independently managed complex procurement engagements through post-signature execution and closeout, with experience in at least one infrastructure category such as land, leases, power, colocation, or fiber.

 - Can distinguish well-structured supplier engagements from those that create avoidable ambiguity or exposure, recommend practical improvements, and recognize when Legal or Accounting judgment is required.

 - Can independently prioritize time-sensitive engagements, navigate ambiguity, and resolve cross-functional dependencies, seeking guidance on complex or consequential decisions. Communicate risks and tradeoffs clearly and influence senior stakeholders without formal authority.

 - Experience across multiple infrastructure categories, CSP commercial models, multi-entity purchasing, milestone payments, or escrow arrangements.

 - Zip, Oracle, Ironclad, or comparable platforms; workflow configuration, low-code tools, APIs, or scripting.

What success looks like:

 - Business, sourcing, Legal, and Finance partners adopt shared operating standards, templates, and early review cycles, improving engagement quality and contracting readiness.

 - Request-to-agreement execution and request-to-PO cycle times improve measurably, alongside fewer preventable delays, missed obligations, invoice exceptions, and financial or contractual exposures.

title: Service Designer, Intelligence & Investigations
description:
About the Team

The Intelligence and Investigations (I2) team provides intelligence to decision makers across OpenAI and investigates severe misuse of our products. I2’s work saves lives: we disrupt real-world violence, protect children, and prevent catastrophic harms from AI misuse. We draw on our investigations and in-depth analysis of a wide range of data sources to provide actionable quantitative and qualitative intelligence to OpenAI’s leadership.

Our analysts and investigators make sense of complex data to understand emerging risks and investigate severe misuse. They work closely with engineers who build tools that extend what human experts can see and do. The design of the investigative workflow shapes how effectively people can use those tools and act on what they learn.

About the Role

We’re hiring a service designer to shape how investigative cases move through OpenAI, from the first signal through review and action. You’ll work alongside investigators to understand what each case requires and how the overall workflow shapes what investigators can accomplish.

You’ll bring that perspective to the people who shape investigative operations and the engineers who build the underlying systems. Together, you’ll decide where a change would help and see how it works in real cases.

In this role, you will

 - Work alongside investigators to understand how cases move across teams and systems. Consider what that process means for people at risk, people whose activity is under review, and the people responsible for acting on a finding.

 - Lead the cross-team work of mapping investigative workflows, designing improvements with the people who use and operate them, and putting agreed changes into practice.

 - Guide engineering decisions about how investigative systems fit together to support the overall workflow.

 - Follow changes into use. Look for whether they help investigators act in time, make well-supported decisions, and sustain demanding work.

 - Have experience designing services around the needs of the people who use and run them.

 - Enjoy learning how specialists work. You can draw on their different perspectives to understand a service that no single team sees in full.

title: Mechanical Engineer (On-site)
description:
ABOUT STANDARD BOTS

At Standard Bots, we're revolutionizing real-world automation by making robotic systems accessible to everyone. Our AI-powered platform enables robots to tackle unprecedented challenges through an intuitive instruction interface, bringing the power of software automation to physical spaces.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

We're building Bolt, a mobile manipulation platform: an autonomous mobile base carrying our robot arms. We're hiring two Mechanical Engineers to join the Bolt team early in their careers and grow with the product. One will work on the upper body — the structures, mounts, and covers that carry the arms, sensors, and payload on the base. One will support the electrical team and proof-of-concept builds — brackets, enclosures, harness routing, test fixtures, and the quick-turn parts that keep prototypes moving. You'll design in SolidWorks, build what you design, and test it on real robots.


📍 LOCATION

This is an on-site role based at our new Boston-area office, where Bolt is designed, built, and tested, with some flexibility on days in the office once you're up to speed. You'll work next to the build area, electronics lab, and test floor. Relocation assistance is available.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design parts and assemblies in SolidWorks — sheet metal, machined parts, 3D prints, and off-the-shelf hardware — and release drawings with correct tolerances and callouts

 - Build and test prototypes: order parts, assemble, instrument, run tests, and document results

Our Workfront System Admin team is responsible for management, configuration, and optimization of the Adobe Workfront work management platform to support marketing workflows, resource allocation and team collaboration. The Administrators act as the primary bridge between technical platform configuration and day-to-day business operations. They ensure that Workfront scales cleanly, meets security and governance standards, and maximizes efficiency across marketing, creative, production, marketing operations, content deployment, IT and other cross-functional project teams.
As a Workfront System Administrator, you will…
Manage day-to-day support, user access, system maintenance, data integrity, solution design, Fusion development, reporting, integrations and new functionality. System Admins partner with process owners and stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable solutions, strengthen governance, increase adoption and deliver durable improvements through an agile delivery model.
